title: DR-21b: malformed GroupContext list fails closed at join
description: Extends DR-21 (mimid-1wgh.4.57) and DR-15c (mimid-1wgh.4.49). A malformed GroupContext safe_aad/app_components ComponentsList at join_welcome, join_external or Observer::from_group_info fails closed with InvalidComponentsList, decoded before anything is stored. Join results use small #[non_exhaustive] structs with named fields instead of tuples (clarity). Approved by Mark 2026-10-18.
